newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE says will extend trading hours from Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE says will extend trading hours from Nov 5.

text.p: The Tokyo International Financial Futures Exchange (TIFFE) said on Thursday it would extend its trading hours from November 5 to increase trading opportunities and invigorate activity.
The exchange will extend daily trading hours by 30 minutes to a total 7-1/2 hours from the current seven hours, TIFFE said.
The new trading hours will be from 9 a.m. to 11.30 a.m. (0000 GMT to 0230 GMT) in the morning and 12.30 p.m. to 3.30 p.m. (0330 GMT to 0630 GMT) in the afternoon.
Trading hours for the night session will be unchanged.
The night session will be from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. (0700 GMT to 0900 GMT).
With the new trading hours, morning trade will end 30 minutes earlier than at present, while afternoon trade will start one hour earlier.

Once the change takes place, the afternoon session will start at the same time as that for bond futures and options trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE), which will increase opportunities for arbitrage trading, TIFFE said.
The afternoon session for bond futures and options trading on the TSE is from 12.30 p.m. to 3 p.m. (0330 GMT to 0600 GMT).
